violations.message: The two repeated button subcircuits are not identical: SW2's passives (R3 offset higher and to the left) do not mirror SW1's arrangement, C2 floats alone between the groups, and R3/R1/R4/R2 do not form a single aligned row, giving a ragged scattered look in the 2D view.

C1 and C5 designators overlap each other directly, the U1 bottom pad row labels (15-26) collapse into one illegible garbled string of overlapping text, and R5/D1 labels nearly collide right of the module.

Large dead regions occupy most of the right half (only J2), the left side, and both bottom corners while all circuitry crowds the center, and J2 is stranded a full board-width from U1 with long ratsnest lines crossing the empty area.
C1/C5 sit immediately adjacent to U1 pins 2 (3V3) and 3 (EN), but C2 (+3V3/GND pads) is stranded mid-board roughly 10mm below the module with resistors and switches between it and any IC power pin.

U1's right pin column places 37:TXD above 36:RXD while J2 orders UART_RX above UART_TX, so the straight TXD->UART_TX and RXD->UART_RX connections cross each other (visible crossing ratsnest lines), forcing an avoidable crossover.

The antenna keepout above U1 is free of components, but it is recessed several millimetres from the top board edge so board material (and potential copper pour) extends beyond the antenna instead of the antenna sitting at the edge.

violations.message: The repeated SW1/SW2 button subcircuits are not identical (SW2's support passives sit in different relative positions than SW1's), and C2, R3/R4 and D1/R5 are scattered with no aligned rows or columns.
C1 and C5 designators overlap each other beside U1, R3/R4 are stacked on top of one another mid-board, and the label row below U1 (pins 15-26) collapses into an illegible jumble overlapping the pads.

Circuitry crowds the top-left quadrant while the bottom-center and most of the right half are large dead regions, and C2 is stranded mid-board far from the U1 power pins it serves with long ratsnest lines crossing the empty area.
C1/C5 sit adjacent to U1's 3V3/EN pins but overlap each other at the board edge, and C2 (+3V3/GND) is stranded mid-board roughly 10mm below U1, far from any IC power pin.

R3/R4 float in open space far from both J1 (bottom-right) and U1 (top-left), so the USB chain stretches diagonally across the whole board with long ratsnest spans instead of reading as an ordered local chain.
Straight pad-to-pad ratsnest lines from U1's TXD/RXD pins to J2 and from R3/R4 to J1 visibly cross each other in the board center, forcing avoidable crossover traces.
VBUS enters at J1 in the bottom-right corner with no visible protection, filter, regulator, or bulk capacitor near it, and the only power-rail cap C2 is stranded mid-board on the opposite diagonal.

C2 is stranded alone mid-board far from U1, R3/R4 float between the switch cluster and nothing, J2 is isolated in the bottom-left corner, and large empty regions on the right and center make the layout read as scattered rather than tight grid-aligned clusters.

violations.message: J1 (USB-C) sits correctly at the bottom-left edge opening outward with a clear approach, but the J2 UART header is placed in the board interior rather than at an edge, so the check is not clearly satisfied for every connector.

The repeated SW1/SW2 button subcircuits do not have identical support-passive layouts (R3/R4 stacked off-grid near SW2 only), and C2, R5/D1 and A1/A4 are scattered rather than forming aligned rows or columns.
The pin-label row below U1 collapses into an illegible overlapping jumble, and the C1/C5 and R3/R4 reference designators overlap each other in the 2D view.

Components crowd the left half while the entire right side and bottom-right of the board are large dead regions, and C2 is stranded mid-board far from any functional group with long ratsnest lines crossing empty area.
C1/C5 sit adjacent to U1 pins 1-2 (GND/3V3), but C2 (+3V3) is placed near header J2 roughly 10+ mm from any IC power pin, not immediately adjacent to the pin it decouples.

The EN button chain (SW2/R1) sits center-right while U1's EN pin (pin 3) is on the module's left side, and UART ratsnest from right-side TXD/RXD pins doubles back diagonally across the bottom pin row to reach J2.

In the 2D view C2 is stranded alone mid-board far from U1, R3/R4 float between the MCU and SW2 rather than sitting with either group, the switch-resistor pairs are not grid-aligned, and the large empty right/bottom regions make the layout read as scattered rather than tight clusters.
